agent.problem: The question asks what “they all” ask without identifying who “they” are. The preceding story card only gives Jesus' statement, so the question depends on earlier cards that are no longer visible; it should name the council.

rule.text: Always give context in the question. The story card before it isn't on screen anymore, so the question says who and what. Never "him," "that" or "it" pointing back to a card the baker can't see.
